about: Slides an expert would accept: the same programme as journey-weak.json, with action titles, content that uses the slide, and labels that fit their boxes. No slide may carry a composition-fault finding or score below the gate.

meta.title: Cloud cost reduction programme
meta.source: Cloud billing exports, Oct 2025 to Sep 2026; FinOps utilisation scan, Sep 2026

slides.title: Cloud spend is 23% over budget; a FinOps programme recovers €9.6M a year

points.lead: Cloud spend is 23 percent over budget.
points.support: Spend reached 41.8 million euros in twelve months.

points.lead: A third of running compute is idle.
points.support: Rightsizing is the largest and fastest lever.

points.lead: Commitment coverage is half the benchmark.
points.support: 3.1 million euros a year is unclaimed.

points.lead: Cold data sits on premium storage.
points.support: Archive classes save 1.4 million euros a year.

points.lead: The programme pays back in weeks.
points.support: 9.6 million euros a year for a one-off 1.2 million.

slides.takeaway: A FinOps programme removes 9.6 million euros of annual cloud run-rate within twelve months.

slides.title: Monthly spend rose 35% in six months and is still accelerating
slides.takeaway: Without action the run-rate passes 50 million euros by March.

slides.title: Only €0.9M of the €9.6M committed has been delivered so far

steps.label: Identified
steps.description: The September utilisation scan identified 14.2 million euros of savings across all seven levers and three business units.

steps.label: Validated
steps.description: Product teams and finance validated 11.0 million euros of that total; the rest depends on workloads due to be retired.

steps.label: Committed
steps.description: Teams committed 9.6 million euros in their budgets for the next twelve months, each lever with a named owner.

steps.label: Delivered
steps.description: Rightsizing in non-production has delivered 0.9 million euros to date; production rightsizing starts in November.

slides.takeaway: Delivery, not identification, is the constraint.

slides.title: Four levers deliver €9.0M of the €9.6M target
slides.takeaway: The remaining levers add 0.6 million euros and can wait for phase two.

slides.title: We recommend option B: €9.6M savings for a €1.2M investment

options.label: Option A: tactical clean-up of idle compute
options.detail: €3.2M of savings with no investment and no new team; the savings erode within a year as estates drift back.

options.label: Option B: FinOps programme with a team of five
options.detail: €9.6M of annual savings for a one-off €1.2M; rightsizing, commitments and storage tiering under one accountable team.

options.label: Option C: re-platform the forty largest workloads
options.detail: €12M of savings after 24 months for a €6M investment, at high delivery risk.

slides.title: Three decisions start the programme on 1 November

steps.action: Approve the €1.2M programme budget and the team of five
Name an accountable owner for each of the seven levers
Start production rightsizing in the three largest estates
Buy committed-use discounts for the steady baseline

decisions: Approve option B and the programme budget
